Always fresh, always delicious and always an excellent source of calcium, protein and vitamin D.

Blueberries range in colour from a deep purple-blue to a blue-black, both with a silvery sheen called bloom. Sweeten your morning by sprinkling blueberries on your cereal or pancakes, or add blueberries to a spinach salad with pecans and blue cheese.

Strawberries vary in colour, shape, and size but their flavour is distinctively sweet. They are topped with a hull of green leaves and are speckled with seeds on the surface. Enjoy yours in classic desserts like strawberry shortcake and strawberry-rhubarb pie, or add them to your next spinach salad with some crumbled goat cheese .
